preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the tree must be between 2 and 300,000.
The number of queries must be between 1 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in parents)
preconditions.description: Each parent index must be a valid node index within the range of 1 to n.
The number of parent indices must be exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= n for vi in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query index must be a valid node index within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be a space-separated string of centroid indices for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= centroid <= n for centroid in centroids)
postconditions.description: Each centroid index must be a valid node index within the range of 1 to n.
The number of centroid indices in the output must match the number of queries.
